Subject: Pilot: guaranteed capacity request for Nimble Health December pilot

Hi David,

Thanks again for the demo last week — really helpful. We are greenlit to run a 3-week production pilot starting Dec 1 and have a tight requirement from our ops team: we need guaranteed dedicated capacity (no preemption) for peak windows to meet our latency SLOs and medical data processing timelines. High-level request:

- Continuous equivalent of 8 A100 GPUs (we can express as vGPU units) for 00:00–06:00 PT daily, with burstable headroom up to 12 GPUs for no more than 6 hours/day during scheduled ingest windows.
- Pilot dates: 2026-12-01 through 2026-12-21 (21 days)
- Compliance note: logs and usage must be retained for 90 days; SOC2 evidence may be requested during pilot.

Can Redwood offer a temporary reservation or dedicated slice and a brief note on expected costs? We attached our SLA requirements and a rough capacity profile.

Attachments: nimble_sla_requirements.pdf, capacity_estimate.xlsx

Happy to jump on a short call with product/ops this week.

Thanks,

Quick ops read and a concrete proposal. TL;DR: feasible with an "accordion" reservation plus a temporary autoscale policy exception and a pre-warm step. Details: 

Proposal (operational model):
- Base reserved slice: 4 non-preemptible GPUs allocated as a dedicated pool for the pilot region (US-west). This covers baseline traffic and reduces cold-start risk.
- Accordion burst band: allow burst up to 12 GPUs via a reserved burst band that is activated during scheduled ingest windows. Bursts will be time-bound and pre-authorized (we mark them in the control plane to prevent overuse).
- Autoscale policy exception: temporarily relax the default hard cap on per-customer burst to permit 12 GPUs for the pilot window; this needs product approval and an ops runbook to rollback at end date.
- Pre-warm: schedule pre-warm jobs 30–45 minutes before ingest windows to populate KV caches.

Operational constraints and asks:
- We need a signed temporary reservation (DocuSign) that includes exact start/end dates and permitted burst hours to enforce the policy.
- Cost estimate (very rough): base 4 GPUs reserved at our Dedicated rate + burst hours at on-demand or reserved burst pricing. Rough ballpark for 21-day pilot: $XXk–$YYk (I'll convert to a tighter number once finance flags the exact SKU pricing).
- SOC2/log retention: we can surface the audit logs and provide 90-day retention; ops needs product to confirm the exact log retention endpoint and any redaction rules.

Risks:
- If burst demand is sustained beyond agreed hours, we will throttle and fall back to queued requests — we should be explicit to Nimble.
- Capacity booking may require shifting a small number of pilot-eligible slots from other labs; need product/risk acceptance.

Next steps:
1) Kimberly: product approval for temporary autoscale exception and confirmation on SLA posture.
2) Evelyn/Laura: give procurement/billing path and estimated committed budget threshold.
3) I can prepare an ops runbook and the DocuSign redline for the temporary reservation.

Attachments referenced: capacity_estimate.xlsx (I used it to build the cost sketch).

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Ops Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-19T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot capacity ask — Nimble Health (Dec pilot)

Thanks Marcus — this plan looks reasonable. Product can greenlight a temporary autoscale exception under strict guardrails: 

- Approve accordion model for pilot window (2026-12-01 to 2026-12-21) with explicit burst windows documented in the DocuSign SOW.
- KPI guardrails: if sustained burst > 4 hours/day for 3 consecutive days, ops auto-triggers a mitigation call and we reserve right to throttle.
- Cost cap: require Nimble to accept a soft budget cap (we'll notify at 75% and 100% burn). If they want continued capacity beyond pilot, escalate to sales for committed reservation.

Evelyn/Laura — please confirm billing route and if Finance needs a PO up front for a temporary reservation. Marcus — please draft the runbook and the DocuSign SOW redline; include explicit retention/log endpoints for SOC2.

Once we have runbook + SOW, David can send the formal offer to Nimble and schedule a short kick-off.

Kimberly Park
VP, Product Management — Dedicated
Redwood Inference
